scope: All source fields of B-authored u17–u32: forms, explanations, examples, vocabulary labels/readings, 96 dialogue turns and text-only questions, 48 MCQ with actual options and why, 32 oral tasks, 16 readings and writing tasks, actual N3/N4 retrieval citations, time/actor/responsibility and allowed alternatives. Reviewer did not modify B source. This is independent AI-agent judgment, not human/native-speaker certification. Rendered/browser/account/build/deployment gates are separate.

findings.problem: Positional last-option explanation contradicted shuffled actual choices.
findings.resolution: Replaced position with exact option strings; then updated again for first-use fix.

findings.problem: Same-cause owner scan found first/second/third explanations out of order.
findings.resolution: Quoted actual sentences instead of positions; design vs ability vs plan checked.

findings.problem: Japanese delay was translated as work finishing late, adding explicit completion.
findings.resolution: Changed Korean to 작업이 늦어졌어요; Japanese meaning retained.

findings.problem: Purpose のに also naturally fits 参加する…必要があります; not uniquely wrong or necessarily adversative.
findings.resolution: Replaced distractor with を, explained attachment and simultaneous ながら difference; now unique には.

findings.problem: Reading said person not yet asked, but answer invented a decided future asking plan.
findings.resolution: Correct answer narrowed to explicit decision to compare prior sheet and letter size.

findings.problem: Question future intent conflicted with reading completed comparison.
findings.resolution: Changed 비교하려는 to 비교한; answer now matches completed event.

findings.problem: 書きはじめません made interpreting an untaught Vます+始める necessary to reject a distractor. Curriculum independently confirmed removal criterion.
findings.resolution: Replaced with 書きません; explanation uses known ordinary negative, with core target なおす vs prior かけ preserved.
